about: Written by e2er at export (2026-10-15) from what the run recorded: the scripts that wrote estimation_results.json, from the estimation script on, in the order the run ran them (its script log); the files they read; and the packages they import. code/requirements.txt pins 4 package(s) at the versions the run used.

inputs.source: the study's database, tables: frankfurt_t2m_annual (made by the study during the run); frankfurt_t2m_clean (made by the study during the run); frankfurt_t2m_monthly (NASA Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER), NASA Langley Research Center, NASA POWER monthly T2M at lat 50.11, lon 8.68, 1981–2025, release v2.10.0, loaded 2026-10-13)

notes: The run recorded no Python version for its scripts (e2er up to 0.16.0), so the recipe names the Python e2er exported the study with (3.12.12); the study may have run on another.
